arxiv-2104-04431.title: “ Thanks for helping me find my enthusiasm for physics! ” The lasting impacts ‘research in schools’ projects can have on students, teachers, and schools
arxiv-2104-04431.creator: Martin O. Archer, Jennifer DeWitt
arxiv-2104-04431.description: Abstract Using 6 years of evaluation data we assess the medium- and long-term impacts upon a diverse range of students, teachers, and schools from participating in a programme of protracted university-mentored projects based in cutting-edge space science, astronomy, and particle physics research.

arxiv-2109-11313.title: Physics-informed neural networks for one-dimensional sound field predictions with parameterized sources and impedance boundaries
arxiv-2109-11313.creator: Nikolas Borrel-Jensen, Allan P. Engsig-Karup, Cheol-Ho Jeong
arxiv-2109-11313.description: Abstract Realistic sound is essential in virtual environments, such as computer games and mixed reality. Efficient and accurate numerical methods for pre-calculating acoustics have been developed over the last decade; however, pre-calculating acoustics makes handling dynamic scenes with moving sources challenging, requiring intractable memory storage.

arxiv-2203-14456.title: 3MASSIV: Multilingual, Multimodal and Multi-Aspect dataset of Social Media Short Videos
arxiv-2203-14456.creator: Vikram Gupta, Trisha Mittal, Puneet Mathur, Vaibhav Mishra, Mayank Maheshwari, Aniket Bera, Debdoot Mukherjee, Dinesh Manocha, ShareChat, India
arxiv-2203-14456.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vikram Gupta, Trisha Mittal, Puneet Mathur, Vaibhav Mishra, Mayank Maheshwari, Aniket Bera, Debdoot Mukherjee, Dinesh Manocha, ShareChat, India. We present 3MASSIV , a multilingual, multimodal and multi-aspect, expertly-annotated dataset of diverse short videos extracted from short-video social media platform - Moj.

arxiv-2208-04797.title: Inferring the heritability of bacterial traits in the era of machine learning
arxiv-2208-04797.creator: T. Tien Mai, John A Lees, Rebecca A Gladstone, and Jukka Corander
arxiv-2208-04797.description: Abstract Quantification of heritability is a fundamental desideratum in genetics, which allows an assessment of the contribution of additive genetic variation to the variability of a trait of interest. The traditional computational approaches for assessing the heritability of a trait have been developed in the field of quantitative genetics.

arxiv-2211-08218.title: Gravitational waves and tadpole resummation: Efficient and easy convergence of finite temperature QFT
arxiv-2211-08218.creator: David Curtin, Jyotirmoy Roy, Graham White
arxiv-2211-08218.description: Abstract We demonstrate analytically and numerically that “optimized partial dressing” (OPD) thermal mass resummation, which uses gap equation solutions inserted into the tadpole, efficiently tames finite-temperature perturbation theory calculations of the effective thermal potential, without necessitating use of the high-temperature approximation.

arxiv-2302-14571.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove that a bijective map φ \varphi over a ring R R with a non-trivial idempotent satisfying φ ⁡ ( a ​ b ) = φ ⁡ ( a ) ​ φ ​ ( b ) , \varphi(ab)=\varphi(a)\varphi(b), for all a , b ∈ R a,b\in R , is additive.

arxiv-2311-09083.title: Structural Advantages for Integrated Builders in MEV-Boost Thanks: We thank Davide Crapis, Julian Ma, Barnabè Monnot, Alex Nezlobin and Thomas Thiery for helpful comments and suggestions.
arxiv-2311-09083.creator: Mallesh M. Pai A {}^{\text{A}}, Max Resnick B {}^{\text{B}}
arxiv-2311-09083.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mallesh M. Pai A {}^{\text{A}}, Max Resnick B {}^{\text{B}}. Currently, over 90% of Ethereum blocks are built using MEV-Boost, an auction that allows validators to sell their block-building power to builders who compete in an open English auction in each slot. Shortly after the merge, when MEV-Boost was in its infancy, most block builders were neutral, meaning they did not trade themselves but rather aggregated transactions from other traders.

arxiv-2402-18558.title: Unifying F1TENTH Autonomous Racing: Survey, Methods and Benchmarks
arxiv-2402-18558.creator: Benjamin David Evans, Raphael Trumpp, Marco Caccamo, Felix Jahncke, Johannes Betz, Hendrik Willem Jordaan, Herman Arnold Engelbrecht
arxiv-2402-18558.description: Abstract The F1TENTH autonomous driving platform, consisting of 1:10-scale remote-controlled cars, has evolved into a well-established education and research platform. The many publications and real-world competitions span many domains, from classical path planning to novel learning-based algorithms. Consequently, the field is wide and disjointed, hindering direct comparison of developed methods and making it difficult to assess the state-of-the-art.

arxiv-2407-12823.title: WTU-EVAL: A Whether-or-Not Tool Usage Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-12823.creator: Kangyun Ning, Yisong Su, Xueqiang Lv, Yuanzhe Zhang, Jian Liu, Kang Liu, Jinan Xu
arxiv-2407-12823.description: Abstract Although Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in NLP tasks, they still need external tools to extend their ability. Current research on tool learning with LLMs often assumes mandatory tool use, which does not always align with real-world situations, where the necessity for tools is uncertain, and incorrect or unnecessary use of tools can damage the general abilities of LLMs.

arxiv-2409-16472.title: Sub-Nyquist USF Spectral Estimation: K K Frequencies with 6 ​ K + 4 6K+4 Modulo Samples
arxiv-2409-16472.creator: Ruiming Guo, Yuliang Zhu, Ayush Bhandari
arxiv-2409-16472.description: Abstract Digital acquisition of high bandwidth signals is particularly challenging when Nyquist rate sampling is impractical. This has led to extensive research in sub-Nyquist sampling methods, primarily for spectral and sinusoidal frequency estimation. However, these methods struggle with high-dynamic-range (HDR) signals that can saturate analog-to-digital converters (ADCs).

arxiv-2501-18871.title: Neural SDEs as a Unified Approach to Continuous-Domain Sequence Modeling
arxiv-2501-18871.creator: Macheng Shen, Chen Cheng
arxiv-2501-18871.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Macheng Shen, Chen Cheng. Inspired by the ubiquitous use of differential equations to model continuous dynamics across diverse scientific and engineering domains, we propose a novel and intuitive approach to continuous sequence modeling. Our method interprets time-series data as discrete samples from an underlying continuous dynamical system , and models its time evolution using Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (Neural SDE), where both the flow (drift) and diffusion terms are parameterized by neural networks.

arxiv-2507-19449.title: A continuous-wave vacuum ultraviolet laser for the nuclear clock
arxiv-2507-19449.creator: Qi Xiao, Gleb Penyazkov, Xiangliang Li, Beichen Huang, Wenhao Bu, Juanlang Shi, Haoyu Shi, Tangyin Liao, Gaowei Yan, Haochen Tian, Yixuan Li, Jiatong Li, Bingkun Lu, Li You, Yige Lin, Yuxiang Mo, Shiqian Ding
arxiv-2507-19449.description: Abstract The exceptionally low-energy isomeric transition in 229 Th at around 148.4 nm offers a unique opportunity for coherent nuclear control and the realisation of a nuclear clock. Recent advances, most notably the incorporation of large ensembles of 229 Th nuclei in transparent crystals and the development of pulsed vacuum‑ultraviolet (VUV) lasers, have enabled initial laser spectroscopy of this transition.

openalex-w2080914865.creator: Teresa Coelho, Luı́s F. Maia, ANA CESARINA FERREIRA DA SILVA, Márcia Waddington‐Cruz, Violaine Planté‐Bordeneuve, Ole Bernt Suhr, Isabel M. Conceição, Hartmut Schmidt, Pedro Trigo, Jeffery W. Kelly, Richard F. Labaudinière, Jason Chan

pmc-10691690.title: Investigation on the fault monitoring of high-voltage circuit breaker using improved deep learning
pmc-10691690.creator: Hao Chen, Chenlei Han, Yucheng Zhang, Zhaoxing Ma, Haihua Zhang, Zhengxi Yuan
pmc-10691690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Mechanical faults are the main causes of abnormal opening, refusal operation, or malfunction of high-voltage circuit breakers. Accurately assessing the operational condition of high-voltage circuit breakers and delivering fault evaluations is essential for the power grid’s safety and reliability. This article develops a circuit breaker fault monitoring device, which diagnoses the mechanical faults of the circuit breaker by monitoring the vibration information data.

pmc-11285236.description: Cirriformia species usually inhabit intertidal zones and deep-sea sediments. Their accurate identification has proven to be challenging. Here, we present the complete mitochondrial genome of one Cirriformia tentaculata_Montagu 1808 specimen collected from China. The total length of the complete mitochondrial sequence of C.

pmc-11435040.title: Genome-Wide Association for Morphological and Agronomic Traits in Phaseolus vulgaris L. Accessions
pmc-11435040.creator: Stephanie Mariel Alves, Giselly Figueiredo Lacanallo, Maria Celeste Gonçalves-Vidigal, Mariana Vaz Bisneta, Andressa Gonçalves Vidigal Rosenberg, Pedro Soares Vidigal Filho, Jiangqi Wen
pmc-11435040.description: Exploring genetic resources through genomic analyses has emerged as a powerful strategy to develop common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris L.) cultivars that are both productive and well-adapted to various environments. This study aimed to identify genomic regions linked to morpho-agronomic traits in Mesoamerican and Andean common bean accessions and to elucidate the proteins potentially involved in these traits.

pmc-11589620.title: Assessing the feasibility of quantum learning algorithms for noisy linear problems
pmc-11589620.creator: Minkyu Kim, Panjin Kim
pmc-11589620.description: Quantum algorithms for solving noisy linear problems are reexamined, under the same assumptions taken from the existing literature. The findings of this work include on the one hand extended applicability of the quantum Fourier transform to the ring learning with errors problem which has been left open by Grilo et al.

pmc-12446157.title: MiR-26b-5p mediates radioresistance and immunosuppression via targeting PRKCD in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-12446157.creator: Xu Chen, Rui Kong, Yaxian Qi, Lingchen Li, Chenrui Yin, Lingyou Sun, Chunli Jian, Ping Cai, Qiao Yang, Jianguo Sun
pmc-12446157.description: PurposeOvercoming miRNA-mediated radioresistance and enhancing its synergy with immunotherapy remained significant challenges.MethodsA total of 23 patients with locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) undergoing thoracic radiotherapy from a single center were enrolled. Pre-radiotherapy blood samples were collected and analyzed using real time qPCR array to detect miRNA expression profiles, identifying differential miRNAs between responders and non-responders.

pmc-12582107.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals T and B cell-related immune features in foot and mouth disease virus-infected mice
pmc-12582107.creator: Yang Wang, Lihong Zhang, Zhao Zhang, Zhihua Chen, Jingru Xu, Han Zhang, Haixue Zheng, Jingjing Pei
pmc-12582107.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). T and B lymphocytes protect against the foot and mouth disease virus (FMDV). They are essential for long-term immunity and viral clearance, but their immunological features in FMDV infection remain unknown. Here, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and conducted integrative analyses to determine cell composition, gene expression, cell-cell communication state, and regulatory network of T and B cells in the spleen of FMDV- and mock-infected mice. Our results revealed variational compositions of immune cells on the subsets level.

pmc-12757477.title: Deciphering the Impact of AKT1 Pathogenic Variants in Juvenile Granulosa Cell Tumors Using a Drosophila Model
pmc-12757477.creator: Reiner A. Veitia, Laetitia Herman, Bérangère Legois, Sandra Claret, Alain Zider, Anne-Laure Todeschini
pmc-12757477.description: Juvenile-type granulosa cell tumors (JGCTs) manifest during the prepubertal period as precocious pseudo-puberty and/or dysmenorrhea. We have previously identified pathogenic variants in AKT1 in JGCTs. This study aims to understand how these variants affect cellular function at the phenotypic and molecular levels using a Drosophila model.

pmc-12980574.title: Substitution Spectrum and Selection at G-quadruplexes in Great Ape Telomere-to-Telomere Genomes
pmc-12980574.creator: Xinru Zhang, Saswat K Mohanty, Francesca Chiaromonte, Kateryna D Makova, Aida Andres
pmc-12980574.description: G-quadruplexes (G4s) are noncanonical DNA secondary structures formed by runs of guanines (stems) connected by other nucleotides (loops). These structures are enriched at regulatory regions such as promoters, CpG islands, untranslated regions (UTRs), enhancers, and replication origins, where they play key roles in transcription and replication.

pmc-13272243.creator: Jong Ha Hwang, Hye Seok Park, Sun Mo Nam, Seung Shin Park, Jung Hee Kim, Min-Sung Kim, Chul-kee Park, Yong Hwy Kim

pmc-13311276.title: Chd7 regulates lipid metabolism and swim bladder inflation in zebrafish
pmc-13311276.creator: Maximilian Breuer, Gabrielle Fortier, Jaskaran Singh, Sophie Charron, Betelhem Kassa, Priyanka Jamadagni, Charlotte Zaouter, Shunmoogum A. Patten
pmc-13311276.description: The chromodomain helicase remodeling enzyme, CHD7, has been directly linked to CHARGE syndrome, however recent studies show a wide variability of pathways regulated by the chromatin remodeling enzyme. Here, we show that chd7 mutant zebrafish present with a collection of dysregulated lipid metabolism enzymes in line with Pparγ regulated lipid metabolism.

pmc-13656700.title: Bioinformatics identification of candidate biomarkers associated with T cell proliferation in atherosclerosis via WGCNA and machine learning
pmc-13656700.creator: Wen Xiong, Xiang Long, Feng Lu, Kun Lin, Zhigang Zhu
pmc-13656700.description: BackgroundAtherosclerosis (AS) is a complex chronic disease caused by the development of atherosclerotic plaques. T cell proliferation exerts a vital influence on development of the AS. This research aimed to conduct a comprehensive analysis to computationally screen candidate T cell proliferation-related biomarkers in AS and to explore their potential molecular mechanisms.
